To get a perfect SAT score, a student must answer all questions correctly. The SAT is scored based on the number of correct answers, so missing any question will reduce the score. While studying, test prep, or taking the test multiple times can improve scores, none of these guarantee a perfect score. Cheating is unethical and not a legitimate way to achieve a perfect score. Therefore, the only way to get a perfect SAT score is to get all the questions right.

Answer: B
